Af al pi shemmuttar leechol ochalin temein velishtot mashkin temeim chasidim harishonim hayu ochlin chullin betohora venizharin min hattumot kullan kol yemehem vehen hannikraim perushim vedavar ze kedushsha yetera hi vederech chasidut sheyyihye nivdal adam uforesh mishshear haam velo yigga bahem velo yochal veyishte immahem. shehapperishut mevia lide tohorat hagguf mimmaasim haraim. vetohorat hagguf mevia lide kedushshat hannefesh min haddeot haraot. ukedushshat hannefesh goremet lehiddamot bashshechina. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 44, Vayikra 20, 6-7)</small> "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai mekaddishchem": berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 1: Shiva mine kelim hen shemmekabbelin tuma min hattora veellu hen. habbegadim. vehassakkin. uchele or. uchele etzem. uchele mattachot. uchele etz. uchele cheres. hare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "mikkol keli etz o veged o or o sak". uvichle mattachot neemar <small>(Bamidbar lo 22)</small> "ach et hazzahav veet hakkasef". uvichle cheres neemar "ucheli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho kol asher betocho yitma veoto tishboru":

Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Bamidbar lo 20)</small> "vechol maase izzim" lerabbot kelim haasuyin min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim umin haatzamot shel izzim vehu haddin lishar mine behema vechayya. aval kelim haasuyin meatzmot haof enan mekabbelin tuma chutz mikkelim haasuyin mikkenaf haazniyya bilvad uvetzat hannaamit hametzuppa hoil vehen domin leetzem mekabbelin tuma kichle etzem. vekarov beenay shettumatan middivre sofrim:

Kelim haasuyin meatzmot chayya shebbayyam umeorah tehorim. kol shebbayyam tahor veeno mekabbel tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras. af haoreg beged mitztzemer haggadel bayyam eno mekabbel tuma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "o veged o or" mippi hashshemua lamdu ma beged min haggadel baaretz af or min haggadel baaretz. chibber min haggadel bayyam im haggadel baaretz afillu chut o meshicha im chibbero chibbur ad shemmesim et shenehen keillu hen echad letuma sheim nitma ze yitma ze hakkol mekabbel tuma:

Yerae li shehakkelim haasuyim meor haof en mekabbelin tuma kemo atzmotav. veim tomar vahare hu kasher lichtov alav tefillin keor behema vechayya. hinne or haddag eno mekabbel tuma velule zuhamato sheenah poseket haya kasher lattefillin hinne lamadta sheaf davar sheeno mekabbel tuma kasher litfillin im en lo zuhama:

Kele zechuchit enan mekabbelin tuma middivre tora vachachamim gazru alehen sheyyekabbelu tuma hoil utechillat beriyyatan min hachol kichle cheres hare hen kichle cheres. umippene shettochan nire kevaran lo gazru alehen sheyyittammeu meaviran ella ad shettigga hattuma bahen ben mittochan ben miggabban kichle mattachot. velo gazru tuma al peshutehen ella al mekabbelehen. veen lahem tohora bemikve. veen sorfin alehen teruma vekadashim shello gazru alehen ella litlot:
Kele gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama leolam tehorin. veen mekabbelin tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim ben peshutehen ben mekabbelehen:
Pil shebbala hutzin vehekian derech hari haose mehen kelim hare hen safek im hem kichle gelalim o kele etz keshehayu. aval kefifa shennitmet uvelaah pil vehekiah derech bet hari hare hi betumatah:

Peshute kele cheres kegon menora vechisse veshulchan shel cheres vechayyotze bahen en mekabbelin tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "asher yippol mehem el tocho" <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "yitma" kol sheyyesh lo toch bichli cheres mekabbel tuma vesheen lo toch tahor:

Kele mattachot echad peshutehen kegon hassakkinim vehammisparayim o mekabbelehen kegon hayyorot vehakkumekumosin hakkol mekabbelin tuma shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar lo 23)</small> "kol davar asher yavo vaesh" ben mekabbel ben pashut. afillu teva o migdal vechayyotze bahen shel mattechet shehen mekabbelin arbaim sea belach o yeter mekabbelin tuma shenneemar kol davar asher yavo vaesh:

Kele etz uchele or uchele etzem mekabbelehen kegon haareva vehachemet vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma middivre tora. aval peshutehen kegon halluchot vehakkisse vehaor sheochlin alav vechayyotze bahen enan mekabbelin tuma ella middivre sofrim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "mikkol keli etz" mippi hashshemua lamdu ma sak sheyyesh lo bet kibbul af kol sheyyesh lo bet kibbul. uchele etzem kichle etz lechol davar. bamme devarim amurim shettumat peshutehen middivre sofrim bishar tumot chutz mittumat midras. aval bemidras hazzav vachaverav mittammein min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 4)</small> "kol hammishkav asher yishkav" kol heasuy lemishkav o lemerkav kemo shebbearnu. vechen keli zechuchit heasuy lemishkav mittamme bemidras middivrehen:
Kol shehu arug ben mitztzemer ufishtim ben mikkanbos o mimmeshi o mishshear devarim haggedelim bayyabbasha hu hannikra beged leinyan tuma. vehallevadim kivgadim lechol davar:

Hassak hu chute sear haggedulin keshalshelet o haarugin kivgadim echad heasuy min haizzim o mitztzemer gemallim o mizzenav hassus vehappara vechayyotze bahen veechad haarig mehen kemo hammartzufin o haggadul kemo chevek shel chamor vechayyotze bo. aval hachavalim vehammeshichot hashshezurin ben min hassear ben mitztzemer ufishtim enan mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman:

Kol hakkelim haasuyin min haggome umin haarava umin hakkanim umikkappot temarim umin healim vehassarigin ukelippe ilanot umin hachelef kegon hakkefifot vehatteraskelin vehammachalatzot vehammappatzot hakkol bichlal kele haetz shehakkol gadel min haaretz keetz. echad keli cheres veechad keli neter lechol davar. kol keli heasuy meheafar min haafarot veachar kach sorfin otan bechivshan hare ze keli cheres. vehattannur vehakkirayim vehakkuppach vechayyotze bahen mishshear habbinyanot sheofin bahen o mevashshelin bahen hakkol mekabbelin tuma din tora vetumatan vetumat keli cheres shava:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 2:
Haose keli kibbul mikkol makom hare ze mekabbel tuma bechol shehu min hattora. veen lichli kibbul shiur. vehu sheyyaase davar shel kayyama sheefshar sheyyaamod. ketzad. haose keli min haor hammatztza shello nitabbed kelal. o min hanneyar af al pi sheen hanneyar mekabbel tuma. o mikkelippat harimmon vehaegoz vehaallon afillu chakakum hattinokot lamod bahen et heafar. o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim. hare ellu mekabbelin tuma. shettinok cheresh shote vekatan yesh lahen maase af al pi sheen lahen machashava. aval haose kelim min hallefet vehaetrog vehaddelaat hayeveshim shechakakan lamod bahen vechol kayyotze bahen. hare hen tehorin lefi shei efshar sheyyaamdu ella zeman muat: 
Kene moznayim vehammachak sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul mattechet. vehaesel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul maot. vekane shel etz sheyyesh bo bet kibbul mayim. umakkel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul mezuza o mekom margalit. umashchezet shel etz sheyyesh bo bet kibbul shemen. veluach pinkas sheyyesh bo bet kibbul shaava. kol ellu vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen peshute kele etz hoil veyesh bahen bet kibbul kol shehu mekabbelin tuma din tora. veen tame min hattora ella bet kibbul levaddo sheyyesh bahen vehameshammesh et bet hakkibbul mishshear hakkeli shebbet hakkibbul tzarich lo. aval hayyater al hatztzorech mishshear hakkeli happashut tahor min hattora vetame middivrehen kemo shebbearnu: 
Bet kibbul heasuy lemalleoto eno bet kibbul. ketzad. bekaat shel etz shechokkin bah bet kibbul vetokin bo hassaddan shel barzel. im shel nappachim hi enah mekabbelet tuma sheaf al pi sheyyesh bah bet kibbul lo naasa ella lemalleoto. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veim hayta shel tzorfin hare zo mekabbelet tuma mippene shehen magbihin et habbarzel bechol et sheyyirtze umekabbetzin et sefot hazzahav vehakkesef hammitkabbetzet sham tachat hassaddan vahare naasa lekabbala. vechen kol kayyotze bo: 
Hakkaf hechakuk shettachat ragle hammittot vehammigdalot vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehu mekabbel tahor veen bo mishshum keli kibbul lefi sheeno asuy lekibbul ella lismoch bo bilvad. shefoferet hakkash mekabbelet tuma kechol kele haetz shemmekabbelin tuma afillu enah yechola lekabbel ella tippa achat. ushefoferet hakkane shechatachah lekabbala enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyotzi et kol hallavan shebbetochah. veim lo nechtecha lekabbala hare hi kifshute kele etz. aval shefoferet shel pakuot vechayyotze bahen enan kelim ella koochalin hen chashuvin: 
Shefoferet shechatachah venatan bah et hammezuza veachar kach netanah bechotel afillu natna shello kederech kabbalatah mekabbelet tuma. kevaah bakkotel im kevaah kederech kabbalatah hare zo mekabbelet tuma. shello kederech kabbalatah tehora. natan hashshefoferet bakkotel veachar kach natan bah hammezuza im hayta kederech kabbalatah hare zo mekabbelet tuma. shello kederech kabbalatah tehora. kevaah bakkotel afillu kederech kabbalatah tehora: 
Keli sheorgin oto min hannesarim o min hashshaam kede sheyyishtechu alav habbegadim vehammugmar millematta kede sheyyitbassemu im haya asuy kechavveret sheen lo karka tahor veim haya bo bet kabbalat kesut hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Sandal shel behema shel mattechet tame veshel shaam tahor sheen ze chashuv mikkele hakkabbala: 
Hatztzorer margalit baor vehotziah venishar mekomah amok hare ze mekabbel tuma ad sheyyifshot. shekkol kele kibbul mekabbelin bechol shehen vahare mekoman kemo kis katan. aval tzeror hammaot eno mekabbel tuma sheen alav tzurat keli:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 3:
Kol keli etz heasuy lenachat afillu eno mekabbel ella davar muat eno mekabbel tuma lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim. vechol keli etz heasuy lehittaltel male verekan kesak afillu haya machazik mea sea veaf al pi sheyyesh lo shulayim hoil veeno asuy lenachat hare ze mekabbel tuma din tora kishar kele kibbul. vechol keli etz shehu setam im hayu lo shulayim leshev alehem al hakkarka kede shello yehe noach lehitgalgel vehaya machazik arbaim sea belach shehen korayim beyavesh eno mekabbel tuma kelal lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim mippene shechezkato sheasuy lenachat. udevarim ellu divre kabbala hen. mippi hashshemua lamdu ma sak shehu mittaltel male verekan af keli etz lo yitma ella im ken haya mittaltel male verekan lehotzi keli etz heasuy lenachat: 
Hakkelim shechezkatan shehen asuyin lenachat kegon shidda teva umigdal vechavveret hakkash vechavveret hakkanim uvor sefina gedola vechayyotze beellu. im hen machazikin arbaim sea en mekabbelin tuma. veellu hen hakkelim shel etz shehen asuyin lehittaltel bimloan. dirdur shemmannichin oto al haagala vekostot hammelachim vaarevat haabbedan uvor sefina ketanna sheenah yechola lehallech beemtza hayyam haggadol vehaaron. kol echad mechameshet kele etz ellu af al pi shehen mekabbelin yoter mearbaim sea hare ellu mekabbelin tuma shello naasu mittechillatan ella lehittaltel melein. ushear kol kele etz im hayu mekabbelin arbaim sea veyesh lahem shulayim chezkatan sheenan asuyin lehittaltel bimloan ulefichach en mekabbelin tuma. vechen kele etzem uchele haor hamekabbelin arbaim sea belach en mekabbelin tuma ella im ken naasu mittechillatan keshehen melein: 
Hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal shel zechuchit habbaim bemidda tehorin ushear kele zechuchit af al pi shemmekabbelin arbaim sea hare hen mekabbelin tuma. veze chomer bichle zechuchit mibbichle etz: 
Kol keli sheyyesh beshibburo amma al amma berum shalosh hare hu machazik arbaim sea belach. ucheshemmoddin et hakkeli moddin oto mibbachutz im haya bo amma al amma berum shalosh af al pi sheen tocho ella pachot mizze hare hu tahor sheen ovi haddefanot memaet. aval ovi haraglayim voovi hazzer im haya lo zer en nimdadin immo: 
Haya betoch hakkeli teva ketanna kegon mucheni shebbetoch hashshidda bizman shehi nishmetet enah nimdedet immah veenah chibbur lah veenah matztzelet immah beohel hammet. veim enah nishmetet nimdedet immah vahare hen kichli echad: 
Haya lakkeli kissuy kamur bizman shehu kavua nimdad immo. eno kavua eno nimdad immo. hayu bo megurot mibbifnim nimdedet immo. veim hayu mibbachutz enan nimdadot immo: 
Keli etz sheeno mekabbel arbaim sea kedarko ella im ken hittahu al tziddo o semacho bedavar acher hoil umekabbel arbaim sea mikkol makom tahor: 
Hashshidda vehatteva shennittela achat meraglehen af al pi shello nikkevu ella hare hen mekabbelin hare ellu tehorin vaadayin yesh lahem shulayim vechezkatan shehen lenachat keshehayu:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 4: Shalosh middot bichle etz sheenan asuyin lekabbala. kol keli etz heasuy letashmish adam bilvad kegon hassullam tahor veeno mekabbel tuma kelal velo ribbuhu chachamim letuma. vechol keli etz heasuy letashmish hakkelim vehaadam kegon hashshulchan vehattavla vehammitta vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma. uminnayin shehen letashmish adam vetashmish meshammeshav shehare manniach hakkearot al hashshulchan vehakkosot al hattavla vehammatztzaot al hammitta. vechol keli etz heasuy letashmish hakkelim bilvad shehare hu meshammesh meshammeshe adam im lo haya meshammesh et hakkelim ella bishat melacha bilvad hare ze tahor mikkelum kegon menora shel etz shemmeshammeshet hanner bishat hadelaka, vechan vehu keli shemmannichin tachat hakkelim bishat melacha, vehaddefusin kullan. veim haya meshammesh et hakkelim bishat melacha veshello bishat melacha hare ze mekabbel tuma kegon kissuy hakkafatza vechayyotze bo vetik hassayif vehassakkin veharomach vehammisparim vehattaar vehammichchol vehammichtav uvet hakkochal vetik tavla usekuretiya uvet hachitztzim uvet happagozot vetik chalalim kol ellu vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheenan ella meshammeshe kelim mekabbelin tuma shehare hakkeli tzarich lahen bishat melacha veshello bishat melacha. aval kissuy kamatra vechissuy teva vechissuy teni vehammachbesh shel charash vehakkisse shettachat hatteva vehakkematin shellah vehakkelev shebbonin alav tik hassappar uvet hanneger vehammanul vehammezuza vetik nevalim vehakkinnorot vehakkelev shel godle mitznefet udefus shel tefillin vesus shel etz shel zemer shemmesachakin bo ureviit hammekonenet ugenonat heani vesamochot hammitta venaklite hammitta vachamor shettachat hammitta kol ellu vechayyotze bahen tehorin mippene shehen meshammeshe hakkelim bishat melacha bilvad:

Malben hammitta im haya melubbash befikot veyesh lo raglayim shemmechabberan im hammitta hare ze mittamme im hammitta shehare notnin oto bifne hammitta vahare hu keechad meevareha. netano al shete leshonot vahare hu gavoah al hammitta af al pi shemmesorag bachavalim hoil veen lo raglayim tahor mippene shehu mimmeshammeshe hakkelim bishat melacha bilvad kemalbene bene levi shettolin bahem kinnorotehen uchele hashsher shehen tehorin:

Machbesh shel shekaf shemmoteach alav et haor tahor mippene shemmanniach alav et haeven bammakom hechakuk sheyyesh bo umeshammesh alav venimtza asuy leshammesh et hakkelim bishat melacha veeno mittamme mishshum kibbul shehare hechakak shebbo asuy lehitmalleot beeven:

Chippuye hammitta tehorin vechen kol hachippuyin ben shehayu shel etz o shel etzem o shel or o shel mattechet tehorin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "asher yease melacha bahen" perat lechippuye hakkelim. vechen kele etz o etzem sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul shetztzippam bemattechet tehorim veen mekabbelin tuma meachar shetztzippam bittelan vehatztzippuy atzmo tahor kemo shebbearnu:

Haose keli miktzato min haetz umiktzato min hammattechet im haya haetz meshammesh hammattechet mekabbel tuma veim hayta hammattechet meshammeshet et haetz hakkol tahor. ketzad. mafteach shel etz veshinnav mimmattechet afillu shen echad hare ze mekabbel tuma. hayta hi mimmattechet veshinnayim shello meetz hakkol tahor:
Tabbaat shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog temea. hayta shel almog vechotamo shel mattechet hare zo enah mekabbelet tuma:

Hashshen shel mattechet o hachotam mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo im lo haya mechubbar laetz. vechen hameabbed vehammazre vehammagov vehammasrek shel rosh shennittela echad mishshinnehen vaasaah shel mattechet hare ellu mekabbelin tuma:
Makkel sheasa berosho masmer kemin rimmon kede sheyyihye ochez bo eno mekabbel tuma. asaahu shello tihye haaretz ochelet et haetz mekabbel tuma:
Vechen makkel shekkava bo masmerim kede lehakkot bo mekabbel tuma shennimtza haetz meshammesh et hammattechet. asaan lenoy eno mekabbel tuma shehare hammattechet meshammeshet et haetz:
Vechen menakkiyyot shel mattechet shekkevaan bammakkel o baddelet lenoy tehorot. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear hakkelim:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 5:
Kol hakkelim en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan. uchele etz meematay mekabbelin tuma. hammitta vehaarisa mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. gamar shello lashuf mekabbelin tuma. hassallim shel etz mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot ektze hassarigim vehaetzim hakketannim hayyotzim al gabbe hassal. hayu hassallim shel temara af al pi shello karat hahutzin mibbifnim mekabbelin tuma shekkach mekayyemin otan. hakkalkala mishsheyyachsom piha veyichrot hahutzim veyigmor et hatteluyot. bet hakkosot vehallaginin af al pi shello karat mibbifnim mekabbelin tuma shekkach mekayyemin otam. hakkenonim hakketannim vehakkelatot mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot hahutzin hayyotzim. hakkenonim haggedolim vehasseyogim haggedolim mishsheyyaase shene dorim larochav shellahen. hannafa vehakkevara vechaf moznayim mishsheyyaase dor echad larochav shellahen. hakuppa mishsheyyaase shete tzefirot larochav shellah. vehaarak mishsheyyaase bo tzefira achat af al pi shello gamar gabbehen mekabbelin tuma shehare niru lema shennaasu vetzurat hakkeli alehen. ha lema ze dome leveged shenneerag miktzato. hammachtzelet mishsheyyichrot hahutzin vezehu gemar melacha. vechol kele hannesarim enan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyitchassemu siftotehen. galme kele etz mekabbelin tuma mishshennaasa hakkeli betzurato. af al pi sheatid letaaro bisrad o lehashevoto bimchoga o leyappoto bammaatzad vechayyotze bemaasim ellu vaadayin hu golem hoil veeno mechussar chakika vahare hishlim chafirato hare ze mekabbel tuma. vechol galme kele etz mekabbelin tuma chutz mishshel eshkeroa sheen hakkeli mimmennu chashuv keli ad sheyyityappe. vekarov beenay shekkele etzem kichle eshkeroa veen galmehen mekabbelin tuma. keli etz sheen alav tzurat keli af al pi shemmishtammeshin bo eno mekabbel tuma. arubbot shel nachtomin shessodrim alehen hachallot keshehen batzek mittammeot shehare tzurat hakkeli alehen. veshel baale battim enan mekabbelin tuma. veim tzevaan besikra o becharkom vechayyotze bahen mittammeot shehare naaset lahen tzurat keli. serod shel nachtomin shennotnin bo hammayim shemmekattefin bo tame veshel baale battim tahor. veim gippefo mearba ruchotav mittamme. nifratz meruach achat tahor. vehalluach sheorchin alav mittamme. keli etz shehassallatim merakkedin alav et hassolet mittamme. veshel baale battim tahor. rachat haggarosot mittammea. shel otzarot tehora shel gittot mittammea veshel goranot tehora. ze hakkelal heasuy lekabbala mekabbel tuma veheasuy lechannes bo tahor: 
Kol hatteloyin tehorin chutz mitteloye nafa shel sallatin uteloy kevarah shel goranot uteloy maggal yad uteloy makkel habballashin mippene shehen mesayyein bishat melacha. ze hakkelal heasuy lesayyeo bishat melacha mittamme litlot bo hakkeli bilvad tahor: 
Nivle hameshorrim mittammein. nivle bene levi shemmezammerin bahen bammikdash tehorin. habbitnon vehanniktemon vehairus mittammein: 
Metzudat hachulda mittamme veshel achbarim tehora lefi sheen lah bet kibbul veen aleha tzurat keli: 
Kotzin sheorgin bahen kemo kefifa shemmannichin bah hatteenim vechayyotze bahen mittammein. vesheorgin bahen ketavnit menora gedola sheotzrin bahen hachittin tehora sheen torat keli aleha: 
Alin shemmesargin otan kemin seyag saviv lapperot tahor. veim asu seyag shel nesarin mittammein: 
Chotel shel hutzin shemmannichin bo harotev vechayyotze bo im hu noten letocho venotel mittocho mittamme veim eno yachol littol ma shebbetocho ad sheyyikraennu o yattirennu o shechashav leechol ma shebbetocho ulezarko tahor. vechen hakkeren shehu mishtammesh bah umashlichah enah mekabbelet tuma. veim chashav aleha mekabbelet tuma: 
Hashshofar eno mekabbel tuma. chatacho lihyot keren tashmish mekabbel tuma: 
Keara shekkevaah beshidda teva umigdal im hi kederech kabbalatah mekabbelet tuma. veim kevaah baddofen shehare enah mekabbelet ad shemmattim shidda al tzidda hare zo mikkelal hashshidda utehora: 
Haakkon veharatov vehakkeluv shel etz tehorin: 
Hammaddaf vehappaltzur umetzudat secharim mittammein shehare tzurat keli alehem: 
Hassafsalin shebbappundekaot veshel melammede tinokot af al pi shehen nekuvin umachnisin bahen et haraglayim tehorim. kavu bahen raglayim bemasmer mekabbelin tuma. ze hakkelal kol shennittal veen raglav nittalot immo tahor. vechol shennittal veraglav nittalot immo tame. veim hayu kullan shel etz o etzem mekabbel tuma. hayta achat meraglav shel even eno mekabbel tuma:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 6:
Kol keli shennitma venishbar achar shennitma venifseda tzurato vetashmisho tahor bishvirato. vechen kelim shennishberu keshehen tehorin shivrehen enan mekabbelin tuma: 
Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver bichli etz o keli etzem veyihye tahor. kol kele baale battim shiuran berimmonim. ketzad. mishsheyyinnakev hakkeli bemotzi rimmon tahor. veharimmon sheamru benoni lo gadol velo katan, lefi daat haroe. veyihyu bakkeli shelosha rimmonim achuzim ze baze. nikkav hakkeli bemotzi zayit usetamo vechazar venikkav bemotzi zayit usetamo [ad shehishlimo lemotzi] rimmon af al pi shehu satum tahor shehare naasu lo panim chadashot: 
Kelim sheasaan mittechilla nekuvin bemotzi rimmon kegon hassal vehappuchlatz shel gemallim vehaappifyarot mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyikkara rubban: 
Appifyarot sheasa lahen kanim lemala ulematta lechazzek tehorot. asa lahen gappayim kol shehen af al pi shekkullah nekuva kemotzi rimmon mekabbelet tuma: 
Kol hakkelim sheenan yecholin lekabbel rimmonim kegon harova vachatzi rova vehakkenonim hakketannim shiuran bemotzi zayit. nigmemu siftotehen im nishar bahen kede lekabbel kol shehu temein: 
Hassallin shel pat shiuran kechikkarot shel pat: 
Kuppat haggannanim mishshettotzi aguddot shel yarak tehora. veshel baale battim bemotzi teven. shel ballanin bigvava: 
Bet kearot sheeno mekabbel kearot hoil umekabbel hattamchuyin hare ze mekabbel tuma. vechen bet hari sheeno mekabbel mashkin hoil umekabbel et hari hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Kol keli etz shennechlak lishnayim tahor veaf al pi shemmekabbelin al dafnotehen beilpasin. chutz mikkelim shel etz shechetzyan o miktzatan keli bifne atzmo mittechillat asiyyatan kegon hashshulchan hakkaful shemmitchilla naasa shene chalakim vahare hu nichpal venifshat. uchegon hattamchuy hammiznon shehu kearot kearot vahare bechol chelek mechalakav kearot shelemot. uchegon hakkisse hakkaful vechol kayyotze beellu. vechen bet laginin uvet hakkosot shel etz shennifchat echad mehen ze shennifchat tahor veeno chibbur lishar habbattim. nifchat hashsheni tahor veeno chibbur lo. nifchatu shelashtan kullan tehorin. vechen kol kayyotze bechelim kaellu: 
Mashpelet sheemtzaitah gevoha vezaviyyoteha yordot venifchata mitztzad echad temea mippene shehi mekabbelet mitztzad hashsheni. nifchata mitztzad hashsheni tehora. hashshulchan vehaddulpeki shennifchatu mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyechalku veyibbadel kol chelek mechavero. nittela achat meraglehen tehora. vechen im nittela hashsheniyya. nittela hashshelishit im chishshev alehem sheyyochal al shulchan ze o al dulpeki zo kemo ochel betavla mekabbelin tuma veim lav tehorin: 
Kele nesarim shennaflu siftotehen tehorin. veim nishar machsom siftotehen kol shehu mekabbelin tuma: 
Tavla shemmilleah etzim utekaah tehora. chippah binsarim mekabbelet tuma: 
Safsal shennitparek tahor. sirgelo bimshichot o bachavalim mekabbel tuma: 
Hassallim shel gemallim hittiran tehorin chazar ukesharan mekabbelin tuma. nimtzeu mittammein umittaharin afillu eser peamim beyom: 
Hashshulchan o haddulpeki shechippan beshayish veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat hakkosot mekabbelin tuma veim chippa hakkol tahor. ben betzippuy omed ben betzippuy sheeno omed ben shechippa et levazbezav ben shello chippan ben shehayu shel etzim chashuvim kegon eshkeroa vechayyotze bo ben shehayu shel shear etzim hoil vechippan kullan tehorin kemo shebbearnu:
